description: This file defines an interface named MetadataStrategyInterface within the Aws\Crypto namespace. It specifies the methods that any class implementing this interface should contain, related to handling encryption metadata in the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: MetadataStrategyInterface
classes.description: An interface that defines methods for saving and loading encryption metadata envelopes according to specific strategies.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores encryption metadata into a strategy-specific location and prepares the arguments for the PutObject operation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Creates a MetadataEnvelope based on the provided arguments, using a specific strategy.
